top_candidate: LIDAR-01: slope-aware scarp-template field plus Steger ridge/valley and Frangi multiscale line consensus
hypothesis: Faults absent from the existing catalogue may leave coherent metre-scale surface scarps that are diluted by 100 m terrain summaries.
mechanism: A fault-related scarp may produce slope-tolerant cross-profile curvature and a scale-persistent, orientation-coherent ridge/valley line; joint evidence is aggregated from 2–20 m scales to the 100 m grid.
non_fault_mimic: Fluvial terrace riser (named primary mimic; roads/canals, channel banks and landslide scarps are additional confounders).

protocol.holdout: Whole fault segments assigned within lidar-covered spatial blocks, with a buffer; catalogue-derived features from visible faults only; visible fault pixels masked exactly.
protocol.range_front_gate: Gain must not be confined to range-front blocks.
